verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents the renewal side: registered agent service costs $249/year and auto-renews at the purchase rate until cancelled, though the rate is subject to change. On exit, the only documented terms are the phrase "until you cancel" and transfer INTO LegalZoom; nothing describes how to cancel, refunds, or moving the registered agent role out so the entity is not left without one. Missing for 10: documented cancellation procedure and refund terms, transfer-out/RA-change-away terms, protections against being stranded on exit, and independent corroboration of renewal/cancellation behavior.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, renewal charges and cancellation or transfer-out terms are documented, so leaving the service does not strand the entity

citations.quote: The service auto-renews at the purchase rate each year until you cancel. The renewal rate is subject to change.
